limitations: Disjoint intersecting closed solids are intentional for low-poly modular art. Not boolean-unioned or watertight as single shells.
Automatic checks validate finite buffers, zero-area triangles, winding/normal consistency,16-bit indices and positive total volume; not gameplay clearance or perfect UV seam art.
Collision GLBs/JSON are separate design guides, not imported runtime colliders.
All floor and wall snapping should be validated in the target importer before production.
